sentences.text: The arguments presently advanced by the learned counsel for the petitioner are not matters which can be considered by this Court at this stage.
The question involved herein is a mixed question of fact and law and the same has to be decided by the court below at appropriate stage.
2. The petitioner had earlier approached the court below through CMP No.128/2016 under Section 239 Cr.P.C. seeking a discharge.
Being a summary trial, the provisions under Section 239 Cr.P.C. is not applicable to the proceedings before the court below.
At the same time, it is open to the petitioner, if so advised, to approach the court below, with a petition under Section 258 Cr.P.C. by taking up all these contentions.
In such case, the court below shall dispose of the application expeditiously; in accordance with law.
With the said liberty to the petitioner to have recourse to such a procedure, this Crl.M.C. is disposed of.
Sd/- B. KEMAL PASHA, JUDGE.
